d:
Suman's journey takes an emotional turn when Rishu runs away from home and comes to live with her. Meanwhile, Shukla Ji apologises for his past actions, and the two decide to start afresh by taking their achaar business directly to the people's doorsteps. But Suman soon faces a difficult realisation when she understands that Rishu needs to return to Dilip's house. Will Suman be able to make the right decision as a mother?
Watch Ep3 to find out!
Stay tuned for Episode 4!
Credits:
Directed by: Apoorv Singh Karki
Produced by: Arunabh Kumar
Created by: Arunabh Kumar & Apoorv Singh Karki
